name: Neural Residual Radiance Fields (ReRF)
definition: A method for representing dynamic radiance fields using a global MLP decoder, an initial explicit feature grid for the first frame, and a sequence of compact motion grids and residual feature grids for subsequent frames to exploit temporal coherence.
summary: Neural Residual Radiance Fields is a compact dynamic scene representation that avoids global canonical spaces by modeling residuals between adjacent frames, ensuring robustness to large motions.
